scope: All twelve study-map families and sixty core topics, their named science subfields, comprehensive Notion course outlines, practical guides, optional pathways and local curricula. Partial foundations do not prove full coverage.

topics.label: Algebra
topics.scope: Six Maths lessons introduce variables, equivalent equations and straight-line graphs, with placement, mixed and seven-day applications. Twenty Linear Algebra lessons add vectors, matrix maps, systems, spaces, basis/dimension, rank/nullity, determinants, projection/least squares, Gram-Schmidt, eigenvectors/diagonalisation and SVD. Each linear-algebra check covers all twenty lessons, with fresh recall and bounded interactive models. Broader algebra, larger or complex spaces, spectral theory, proofs, general symbolic methods and independent learner-trial evidence remain.

topics.label: Calculus
topics.scope: Twelve published lessons cover elementary limits, continuity, secants and tangents, polynomial derivatives, a chain rule, motion, extrema, antiderivatives, rectangle sums, signed integrals, the fundamental theorem and net change. Includes twelve-problem placement, mixed and seven-day delayed checks. Formal proofs, unbounded limits, general function families, product/quotient rules, broader applications and integration techniques, series, differential equations and multivariable calculus remain.

topics.label: Geometry
topics.scope: Twelve lessons introduce angles, perimeter and area, composite shapes, circles, similarity and area scaling, right-triangle and coordinate distances, rectangular-solid volume and box surface area. Includes twelve-question placement, mixed and seven-day delayed application sets. Formal proof, congruence, parallel-line geometry, constructions, general polygons, trigonometry, circle theorems, curved solids and independent learner-trial evidence remain.

topics.label: Probability and Statistics
topics.scope: Six published lessons cover finite outcomes, conditional probability, independence, centre, population spread and sampling selection. Distributions, inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and the wider subject remain. Each taught lesson is assessed in distinct six-problem placement, mixed and seven-day delayed sets.

topics.scope: No published Discere teaching sequence yet.

topics.label: Physics (Mechanics, Thermodynamics, Quantum Mechanics)
topics.scope: Eighteen published lessons cover one-dimensional motion, Newton's laws, support, friction, work, kinetic and gravitational energy, energy accounting, power, impulse and sticking collisions. Includes eighteen-problem placement, mixed and seven-day delayed checks. Two-dimensional motion, rotation, circular motion, gravitation, oscillations, fluids and wider mechanics remain; thermodynamics and quantum mechanics remain unimplemented.

namedSubfields.label: Mechanics
namedSubfields.scope: Eighteen published lessons cover one-dimensional motion, Newton's laws, support, friction, work, kinetic and gravitational energy, energy accounting, power, impulse and sticking collisions. Includes eighteen-problem placement, mixed and seven-day delayed checks. Two-dimensional motion, rotation, circular motion, gravitation, oscillations, fluids and wider mechanics remain; thermodynamics and quantum mechanics remain unimplemented.

topics.label: Biology (Genetics, Ecology, Evolution)
topics.scope: Sixteen published lessons connect cell structures, diffusion and osmosis, enzymes and fair comparisons, photosynthesis and respiration, complementary DNA, mitosis and meiosis, Mendelian inheritance, mutation and natural selection, food webs, trophic energy, population limits and ecological evidence. Includes sixteen-problem placement, mixed and seven-day delayed checks. These are introductory foundations. Gene expression, molecular regulation, linkage and wider inheritance, evolutionary evidence and speciation, quantitative population genetics, biodiversity, nutrient cycles, field methods, organismal biology and physiology remain.

namedSubfields.label: Genetics
namedSubfields.scope: DNA copying, chromosome counts, mitosis/meiosis, simple dominance and mutation are taught. Gene expression and regulation, protein synthesis, non-Mendelian inheritance, linkage, genetic methods and quantitative genetics remain.

namedSubfields.label: Ecology
namedSubfields.scope: Food webs, stated trophic efficiencies, population limits and fair comparisons are taught. Nutrient cycles, biodiversity, community dynamics, biomes, field sampling, conservation and fuller quantitative models remain.

namedSubfields.label: Evolution
namedSubfields.scope: Heritable variation, differential reproductive success, context-dependent advantage and alternative causes of frequency change are introduced. Evolutionary evidence, phylogeny, speciation, population-genetic models and broader mechanisms remain.

topics.label: Chemistry (Organic, Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry)
topics.scope: Twelve published lessons cover atomic identity, isotopes, ions, first-eighteen-element shell populations, neutral ionic formulas, simple Lewis structures, formula counts and masses, moles, balancing, stoichiometric ratios and limiting reactants. Includes twelve-problem placement, mixed and seven-day delayed checks. These are general chemistry foundations. Periodic trends, nomenclature, molecular geometry, bonding theory, thermochemistry, states of matter, solutions, equilibrium, kinetics, acids and bases, redox/electrochemistry, organic pathways, broader inorganic chemistry and analytical measurement methods remain.

namedSubfields.label: Inorganic Chemistry
namedSubfields.scope: Introductory atomic structure, simple bonding, ionic formulas and stoichiometry are taught. Descriptive inorganic chemistry, periodic trends, coordination chemistry and wider theory remain.
